verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a Xero integration where pay types are mapped to Chart of Accounts, with department/office/employee-level overrides, indicating automated journal entry sync to Xero specifically. However, evidence is Xero-only — no QuickBooks sync is documented, and details on frequency/automation of the sync (e.g., per pay run automatic push) are thin. Missing for 10: QuickBooks integration evidence, explicit confirmation of fully automatic (vs. manual-trigger) journal entry posting, and independent/hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
